nodes.text: Is HMPV just another seasonal flu in disguise? 🤒 With its mild effects for most, fear not. Testing remains limited, yet this common respiratory virus can be risky for vulnerable groups. Expect more headlines as awareness grows, but don't panic—it's part of the usual viral mix.
